en-US.name: Phone Reader
en-US.summary: Reads notifications from your personal Android phone.
en-US.description: Phone Reader allows you to securely ask your Echo device to read active notifications from your personal Android phone, including WhatsApp, Instagram, and Gmail messages.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Phone Reader to read my notifications
Alexa, ask Phone Reader what my latest notification says
Alexa, ask Phone Reader to read my WhatsApp notifications
